summary.text: Jen Mazzuckelli is the Democratic nominee, a former human-resources professional and high school English teacher. She describes her campaign as centered on congressional oversight of the executive branch and responsiveness to constituents, drawing on her experience with economic hardship.

paragraphs.text: Describes growing up in a middle-class family of public servants; her mother was a teacher and her father retired from the Public Health Service.
Graduated from Glen Este High School in Clermont County, Ohio, and attended Trinity College in Washington, D.C., before earning a bachelor's degree from Illinois College (1991).
Earned a graduate degree from Miami University of Ohio (2005).
Worked in human resources, then became a licensed teacher and taught high school English until 2013.

Says her life changed in 2013 with a domestic-violence case against her husband and a multiple sclerosis diagnosis, after which her family fell to an "extremely low" income level; she cites that experience as a reason for running.
Describes community service as a Girl Scout leader and assistant coach for Girls on the Run.
